commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: Evaluate MCP server tool schema quality and generate an HTML report. Uses a locally installed coding agent (GitHub Copilot or Claude Code) to score semantic checks. If no agent is detected, the command stops after writing the checklist so you can score it manually with your own LLM, or pass --eval-engine none to skip agent probing entirely. Only run this against MCP servers you trust: the server's tool names and descriptions are sent to a locally running coding agent.

options.name: --server-url
options.description: MCP server Streamable HTTP endpoint URL

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for evaluation artifacts

options.name: --eval-engine
options.description: Which local coding agent scores semantic checks. auto: try github-copilot then claude-code. github-copilot or claude-code: use only that engine. none: skip automatic scoring and expect the checklist to be pre-scored (bring-your-own-LLM).

options.name: --auth-token
options.description: Bearer token for MCP server authentication. Prefer the A365_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable; a token passed on the command line is visible to process listings (ps / Task Manager) and shell history.

commands.name: setup
commands.description:
Set up your Agent 365 environment.

Recommended:
  a365 setup all                       Full setup in one command (preferred)

Granular subcommands (for re-runs or partial setup):
  a365 setup requirements              Validate prerequisites
  a365 setup blueprint                 Create the agent blueprint (Entra app)
  a365 setup permissions mcp           MCP server permissions (when using MCP tools)
  a365 setup permissions bot           Bot API + Observability + Power Platform
  a365 setup permissions custom        Inline custom resource permission (--resource-app-id, --scopes)
  a365 setup permissions copilotstudio Copilot Studio agent permissions

Roles required:
  - Agent ID Developer                  Blueprint + inheritable permissions
  - Global Administrator                Tenant-wide OAuth2 consent grants

Non-admin flow: any step that needs Global Administrator action prints
an admin-consent URL (and, when needed, a PowerShell snippet)
that an admin can run out-of-band.

commands.name: requirements
commands.description:
Validate prerequisites for Agent 365 setup
Runs modular requirement checks and provides guidance for any issues found

This command will:
  - Check all prerequisites needed for Agent 365 setup
  - Report any issues with detailed resolution guidance
  - Continue checking all requirements even if some fail
  - Provide a summary of all checks at the end

commands.name: all
commands.description:
Run complete Agent 365 setup (all steps in sequence)
Includes: Infrastructure + Blueprint + Permissions + Endpoint

Minimum required permissions (Global Administrator has all of these):
  - Azure Subscription Contributor (for infrastructure and endpoint)
  - Agent ID Developer role (for blueprint creation)
  - Global Administrator (for permission grants and admin consent)

options.description:
AI Teammate agent: setup provisions blueprint and permissions only.
Omit for blueprint-only agent (default): setup auto-creates agent identity SP; no Entra user.
Overrides the aiTeammate field in a365.config.json

options.description: Skip all setup steps and only run agent registration (non-M365 agents only)

options.description: Treat this agent as an M365 agent. When set, registers the messaging endpoint via MCP Platform. Default is false (opt-in); omit this flag for non-M365 agents.

options.name: --agent-name
options.description:
Agent base name (e.g. "MyAgent"). When provided, no config file is required.
Derives AgentIdentityDisplayName="<name> Identity" and AgentBlueprintDisplayName="<name> Blueprint".
TenantId is auto-detected from 'az account show' (override with --tenant-id).
ClientAppId defaults to the first-party Agent 365 CLI enterprise application, then falls back to a tenant-owned "Agent 365 CLI" app.

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Azure AD tenant ID. Overrides auto-detection from 'az account show'.

options.name: --authmode
options.description:
Authentication pattern for the agent identity (blueprint agents only).
obo  — on-behalf-of (default); principal-scoped delegated grants; no admin consent needed.
s2s  — service-to-service; app permissions on agent identity; Global Admin needed or PowerShell fallback.
both — delegated grants (OBO) and app permissions (S2S).
Not supported with --aiteammate true.

options.name: --skip-sp-provisioning
options.description:
Skip the interactive in-line provisioning of missing resource service principals.
Default: setup detects resources (e.g. V2 MCP per-server audiences) whose SP is missing
from this tenant, prompts per-resource, and shells out to 'az ad sp create --id <appId>'
using the operator's existing az login. With --skip-sp-provisioning, missing SPs are
excluded from the unified admin-consent URL and surfaced as numbered items in the Action
Required block, each with the az command and a per-SP consent URL.
Implicitly enabled when stdin is redirected (CI / coding-agent / pipe scenarios).

options.name: --messaging-endpoint
options.description:
HTTPS URL where the deployed M365 agent receives messages (--m365 only).
When supplied, the endpoint is registered as part of setup. When omitted, an
interactive run prompts for it and a non-interactive run defers it — the endpoint
is a post-deploy artifact, so it can be set later with
'a365 setup blueprint --endpoint-only --messaging-endpoint <url>'.
